description: Returns information about the current supply.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

result.description: An object with the following fields:

result.context.description: The information about the current state of the program

result.context.apiVersion.description: The version of the Solana RPC API to use

result.context.slot.description: An integer representing the slot for which to retrieve the fee calculator

result.value.description: A JSON object with the following fields:

result.value.circulating.description: The total circulating supply of SOL tokens, encoded as u64 integer

result.value.nonCirculating.description: The total non-circulating supply of SOL tokens, encoded as u64 integer

result.value.nonCirculatingAccounts.description: An array containing the public keys (addresses) of accounts holding non-circulating tokens

result.value.total.description: The total amount of SOL tokens
